sources.entry: Budibase | Low-code platform for internal tools, forms and workflows

summary.one_liner: Budibase is an open-source operations platform for building AI agents, internal apps, and automations, self-hostable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Digital Ocean, or available as a hosted cloud service.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Budibase as a platform for running business operations through AI agents, apps, and automations. Agents are said to handle requests such as approvals, record creation, app updates, and team notifications. It integrates with databases, AI models, and business apps. It provides a public API that the README says allows Budibase to be used as a backend. Self-hosting is supported on Docker (including a single ARM-compatible image), Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Digital Ocean, and Portainer, with a managed Budibase Cloud option. The README says admins can globally manage users, onboarding, SMTP, apps, groups, and theming. The monorepo is managed with lerna and has builder (Svelte), client (browser runtime that renders apps from JSON definitions), and server (Koa app) packages.
use_cases: run AI agents for employee requests
provide a backend via a public API
manage user groups and access for internal apps
how_to_run: Self-host with Docker (single ARM-compatible image or Docker Compose)
Or sign up for Budibase Cloud (hosted)
For contributing, see CONTRIBUTING.md for environment setup
notable: AI agents that run approvals, records, and notifications across business systems
Self-hostable with Docker, Kubernetes, Digital Ocean, or Portainer
Public API for using Budibase as a backend
Monorepo split into builder, client, and server packages
Open-source core with a hosted cloud option
caveats: Paid features are under the Business Source License, not GPL v3
Self-hosting requires your own infrastructure and setup
Contributors are asked to open an issue before implementing large features or API changes
summary.license: GPL v3 for core; client and component libraries MPL; paid features under Business Source License
